open_questions: Particle/Effect virtual functions at 0x08124c72..0x08124e98 and 0x0812532a, 0x08127ad0, 0x081281e0 etc. (vtable slots 0-5) have no decompiled body in the manifest (Ghidra did not create functions there); Particle::Update, Particle D1/D0 destructors and Emitter::Update are therefore untranslated and not in any chunk.

FxBinding_ResolveFrame (0x08124498) always returns 0, so any bound effect fails ResolveBinding; unclear whether this is a dedicated-server stub. Binding key semantic (entity number + tag?) is unknown.

Class sizes of Cloud, Line, Tail, Cylinder, Emitter and OrientedParticle are unconfirmed (constructors are in the effects pool allocator callers, not seen); the template struct layout beyond curves[24] at +0x100 is unknown.
Effect flag bit meanings (0x20 collide, 0x400 kill on impact, 0x800 impact effect etc.) are inferred from usage only; 0x30/0x34/0x38/0xb0/0xb4 fields of Effect are unnamed.

Names for merged symbols Hunk_Alloc and XModel_FindOrLoad were used as supplied; the call at 0x08124628 passes Fx_AllocCallback twice, consistent with an allocator pair but the first argument being a name string is unverified.
